DESCRIPTION:
This recently renovated top floor four-bedroom apartment is the ideal set up for roommates. Completely repainted, refurbished appliances including dishwasher in kitchen and brand-new laminate flooring throughout. Tons of light throughout. One Bedroom in the front of the unit with views of Twin Peaks, with the remaining three set off to the back, all four with large closets. Living room, dining room and kitchen all connected and open, great for entertaining. Two full bathrooms, shower over tub in back bathroom.
Centrally located on Albion and 16th Street a block away from Valencia Street, home to San Francisco's best cafes, bars, and restaurants as well as a commuters dream near 16th and Mission Bart Station, 280 S and Muni lines on Market Street and Church Street. Whole Foods Supermarket is 2 blocks away.
